facts.business: Global Ocean Logistics India Limited provides multi-modal logistics and freight-forwarding services by sea, air, and road, including Container Freight Station (CFS) operations and local handling charges.

segments.name: Ocean Freight and CFS & Local Charges

key_risks: Volatility in global freight rates, fuel prices and foreign exchange rates impacting margins
Intense competition from organised and unorganised freight-forwarding players operating on thin margins
Dependence on overseas agents and partners for cross-border service delivery and exposure to global trade and geopolitical disruptions
